import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))


class DoctorTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_secrets_redacted_and_sources_shown(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            with open(os.path.join(tmp, ".env"), "w") as f:
                f.write('export PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN="tok-123"\nPAYHOOK_TIMEOUT=\'20\'\n')
            env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("PAYHOOK_")}
            env.update(PYTHONPATH=ROOT, PAYHOOK_WEBHOOK_SECRET="whsec-9", PAYHOOK_REGION="us")
            out = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "payhook", "doctor"], cwd=tmp,
                                 capture_output=True, text=True, env=env).stdout
        self.assertNotIn("tok-123", out)
        self.assertNotIn("whsec-9", out)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_TIMEOUT = 20  (from .env)", out)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_REGION = us  (from env)", out)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_ENDPOINT = https://api.payments.example/v1  (from default)", out)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
